dict.string: Garage requires permission to communicate with system applications for indexing data.
Garage requires access to system and user directories (including Messages and Mail) to index your personal knowledge base locally.
Garage needs access to your Documents folder to index documents.
Garage needs access to your Downloads folder to index files.
Garage needs access to your Desktop folder to index files.
Garage accesses contacts to resolve author identities and communications.
Garage accesses calendar events for local knowledge retrieval.
Garage accesses reminders for local knowledge retrieval.
